title: Metabolic Risk Factors and Impact of GLP-1 on Perioperative Outcomes After Major Hepatectomy
official: Metabolic Risk Factors and Impact of GLP-1 on Perioperative Outcomes After Major Hepatectomy, an International Multicenter Retrospective Cohort Study
summary:
The goal of this retrospective observational cohort study is to learn how metabolic health factors and the use of GLP-1-related medications affect recovery and complications after major liver surgery in adults undergoing removal of three or more liver segments (major hepatectomy). The study aims to improve understanding of which patients are at higher risk of complications and how care before and after surgery can be optimized.

The main questions it aims to answer are:

Is the use of GLP-1 medications (used for conditions such as diabetes and obesity) associated with serious complications after major liver surgery, including post-hepatectomy liver failure? Which patient characteristics, metabolic risk factors, and treatment factors can help predict the risk of complications after major liver surgery? Does GLP-1 medication use influence the risk of breathing complications, including aspiration (stomach contents entering the lungs)? Are metabolic risk factors or GLP-1 medication use associated with longer-term outcomes, such as chronic pain after surgery?

Researchers will compare outcomes between patients with different metabolic risk profiles and different exposures to GLP-1-related medications to understand whether these factors are associated with differences in recovery after surgery.

Participants will:

Not be asked to undergo any additional tests or treatments as part of this study.

Have information from their previous medical care analysed, including medical history, medications, surgical details, anaesthesia management, and recovery after surgery.

Contribute to a large international database of approximately 10,000 patients who underwent major liver surgery between January 2015 and June 2026.

The information collected in this study may help healthcare professionals better identify patients at increased risk of complications and develop improved strategies to prepare patients for major liver surgery in the future.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Adult patients ≥ 18 years undergoing major hepatectomy (3 or more segments)

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients who objected against the use or re-use of their data for research purposes.
